children: Nigeria's economy grew 4.43% year-on-year in the second quarter of 2026, up from 3.89% recorded in the preceding quarter, official data showed on Monday.
Growth accelerated in both the oil and non-oil sectors compared with the first quarter, the National Bureau of Statistics said in a report.

Africa's most populous nation's economy has been gathering momentum, expanding 3.87% in real terms in 2025 compared with 3.38% in 2024. However, growth remains well below the 7% annual rate that President Bola Tinubu has targeted by 2027.
